paite: Huai ni in mite zak in Mosi laibu asim ua; Ammon mi leh Moab mi tangtawn in Pathian khawmpi sung a alut ding uh ahi kei chih, huai sung a kigelh amu uhi.
heading: Namdang Mite Toh Kikhenna
english: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the hearing of the people; and it was found written in it that an Ammonite and a Moabite should not enter into the assembly of God forever,

paite: Tanghou leh tui a Israel suante dawn lou a, amaute hamsiat ding a, amaute siatna ding a Balaam alak ziak un: himahleh i Pathian in hamsia vualzawlna asuaksakta hi.
english: because they didn’t meet the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them to curse them; however, our God turned the curse into a blessing.

paite: Dan azak lai un, hichi ahong hi a, gamdangmi suante a pan Israel mite akikhenkhe tuamta uhi.
english: It came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated all the mixed multitude from Israel.

paite: Huan hiai ma in, siampu Eliashib i Pathian inn ua dantante tung a seh a ompa, Tobiah toh kizom in,
heading: Nehemiah Puahthaknate
english: Now before this, Eliashib the priest, who was appointed over the rooms of the house of our God, being allied to Tobiah,

paite: ama a ding in dantan thupi abawlkhol a, huai ah amalam in anpiak thillatte, begaw leh tui-um belsuante leh buh-le-bal, uain leh thaute sawm-a-khatte akoih ua, huaite bel Levi mite leh lasa mite leh kongkhak ngak mite kiang a thupiak a piak ahi a; huan vei thillatte siampute a ding in.
english: had prepared for him a great room, where previously they laid the meal offerings, the frankincense, the vessels, and the tithes of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, which were given by commandment to the Levites, the singers, and the gatekeepers; and the wave offerings for the priests.

paite: Himahleh hiai hunte in, Jerusalem ah ka om kei: Babulon kumpipa Artaksarses kum sawmthum-le-nih kum in kumpipa kiang ah ka hoh a, ni bangzah hiam nung in kumpipa phalna ka ngen hi.
english: But in all this, I was not at Jerusalem; for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I went to the king; and after some days I asked leave of the king,

paite: Huchi in Jerusalem ah ka hong a, Pathian inn pisate sung dantan amah a dia abawlsakna ah, Eliashib in Tobiah a dia gilou ahihdan ka theisiam hi.
english: and I came to Jerusalem, and understood the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in preparing him a room in the courts of God’s house.

paite: Huchi in kei hon dahsak mahmah a: huaiziak in dantan a kipan in Tobiah inn van tengteng ka lawnkhia hi.
english: It grieved me severely. Therefore I threw all Tobiah’s household stuff out of the room.

paite: Huan thu ka pia a, dantante ahihsiang ua: huai ah anpiak thillatte leh begaw toh, Pathian inn a tui-um belsuan ka hon la nawn hi.
english: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the rooms. I brought into them the vessels of God’s house, with the meal offerings and the frankincense again.

paite: Levi mite tante amau kiang ah piak nai louh in a-om chih ka thei a; huchi in Levi mite leh lasa mite, nasep semte michih aloulam ah ataizak uhi.
english: I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them, so that the Levites and the singers, who did the work, had each fled to his field.

paite: Kei tuh vaihawmte toh ka kiselta ua, bang ding a Pathian inn mangngilh a om ahia? ka chi hi. Amau ka kaikhawm a, amun uah ka koih hi.
english: Then I contended with the rulers, and said, “Why is God’s house forsaken?” I gathered them together, and set them in their place.

paite: Judah tengteng in buh-le-bal leh uain leh thau sawm-a-khat sumbawm ah ahon tawi uhi.
english: Then all Judah brought the tithe of the grain, the new wine, and the oil to the treasuries.

paite: Sumbawm a ding in sumkem mite ka bawl a, Shelemiah siampute, Zadok laigelhmite leh Levi mite lak ah Pedaiah. Huan amaute zom in Zakkur tapa Hanan, Mattaniah tapa: muanhuai a sim ahi ngal ua, anasep uh a-unaute uh kiang a hawm ding ahi.
english: I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah; for they were counted faithful, and their business was to distribute to their brothers.

paite: Aw ka Pathian, hiai thu ah hon theigige inla, ka Pathian inn a ding a ka nasep hoih ka hihte leh huai a zuih dingte nulmang ke'n.
english: Remember me, my God, concerning this, and don’t wipe out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for its observances.

paite: Huai lai in Judah ah Sabbath ni a kuate hiam uain suknate chil a, buhphalte hon tawi a, huaite toh asabiltungte van guang ka mu a; uain, grep gahte, theipite van puakgik chi chih, Sabbath ni a Jerusalem a hon tawilutte leng; huan an nekte azuak ni uh huai ni in amaute dem in thu ka gen hi.
english: In those days I saw some men treading wine presses on the Sabbath in Judah, bringing in sheaves, and loading donkeys with wine, grapes, figs, and all kinds of burdens which they brought into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day; and I testified against them in the day in which they sold food.

paite: Huai ah Tura mite leng a-om ua, ngasa ahon tawi ua, van chi tuamtuam toh, Judah tate kiang leh Jerusalem ah Sabbath ni in azuak uhi.
english: Some men of Tyre also lived there, who brought in fish and all kinds of wares, and sold on the Sabbath to the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in ke'n Judahte miliante ka kiselpih a, akiang uah, "Bang thil gilou ahia hiai na hih ua, Sabbath na hihnit uh?
english: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said to them, “What evil thing is this that you do, and profane the Sabbath day?

paite: Na pipute un huchibang in ahih ngei ua hia, i Pathian in eite tung leh hiai khopi tung ah hiai hoih lou tengteng hon tun ahi kei maw? Hinapi in nou Sabbath hihnin in Israel tung ah thangpaihna tamsem na tun ua," ka chi hi.
english: Didn’t your fathers do this, and didn’t our God bring all this evil on us and on this city? Yet you bring more wrath on Israel by profaning the Sabbath.”

paite: Huan Jerusalem kongpite Sabbath ni ma a khua amial pat in, hichi ahong hi a, kongkhakte khak ding in thu ka pia a, Sabbath ni abei matan kihong lou ding in thu ka pia a, ka sikhate lak a akhen kongpi tung ah ka pangsak a, huchi a Sabbath ni a puakgik ahong kilaklutlouhna ding in.
english: It came to pass that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the Sabbath, I commanded that the doors should be shut, and commanded that they should not be opened until after the Sabbath. I set some of my servants over the gates, so that no burden should be brought in on the Sabbath day.

paite: Huchi in khatvei hiam nihvei hiam sumsin mite leh van chiteng zuak mite Jerusalem polam ah agiak uhi.
english: So the merchants and sellers of all kinds of wares camped outside of Jerusalem once or twice.

paite: Amaute dem in thu ka gen a, akiang uah, "Bangziak a kulhbaang kim a giak na hi ua? Na hih nawn uleh, na tung uah khut ka kha ding," ka chi lai hi. Huai hun a kipan in Sabbath ni in ahong pai nawnta kei uhi.
english: Then I testified against them, and said to them, “Why do you stay around the wall? If you do so again, I will lay hands on you.” From that time on, they didn’t come on the Sabbath.

paite: Kihihsiangthou ding leh hong kuan a kongpite ngak ding, Sabbath ni siangsak ding in, Levi mite thu ka pia hi. Aw ka Pathian, hiai ah leng kei hon theigige in, na zahngaihna letdan dungzui in kei hon hawi in.
english: I commanded the Levites that they should purify themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the Sabbath day. Remember me for this also, my God, and spare me according to the greatness of your loving kindness.

paite: Huai lai in Judate Ashdod, Ammon leh Moab numeite kitenpihte leng ka mu hi:
english: In those days I also saw the Jews who had married women of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab;

paite: Huchi in atate'n Ashdod pau kimkhat leh namdangte pau azang ua, Judate pau in apau thei kei uhi.
english: and their children spoke half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews’ language, but according to the language of each people.

paite: Amaute ka kiselpih a, ka hamsiatkhum a, alak ua kuate hiam ka khen a, amul uh ka bohkhiaksak a, Pathian min lou in ka kichiamsak a, "Na tanute uh atapate uh a ding in na pe kei ding ua, na tapate uh a ding hiam, noumau a ding hiam in leng atanute uh na la ding uh ahi kei chi in.
english: I contended with them, cursed them, struck certain of them, plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, “You shall not give your daughters to their sons, nor take their daughters for your sons, or for yourselves.

paite: Israel kumpipa Solomon hiaite in akhial kei maw? Hinapi in lah nam tampite lak ah amah bang kumpipa a-om kei a, a Pathian it in a-om a, Israel tengteng tung ah Pathian in kumpipa in abawl hi. Himahleh amah nangawn numei lamdangte'n akhialsak uhi.
english: Didn’t Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? Yet among many nations there was no king like him, and he was loved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel. Nevertheless foreign women caused even him to sin.

paite: Ahihleh hiai gilou mahmah hih ding in, numei lamdangte kitenpih a i Pathian tung a talek ding in, na thu hon zui ding ka hi uh maw?"
english: Shall we then listen to you to do all this great evil, to trespass against our God in marrying foreign women?”

paite: Joiada tapate lak a khat, siampu lianpen Eliashib tapa, Horon mi Sanballat tanu' pasal ahi a; huaiziak in kei a kipan ka delhkhia hi.
english: One of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite; therefore I chased him from me.

paite: Aw ka Pathian, siamputna, siamputna thukhun leh Levi mite ahihnit ziak un, amaute theigige in.
english: Remember them, my God, because they have defiled the priesthood and the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites.

paite: Huchi in mikhualte tengteng a kipan in amaute ka hihsiang a, siampute a ding leh Levi mite a ding in, michih anasep uah, nasepdante ka sehsak a;
english: Thus I cleansed them from all foreigners and appointed duties for the priests and for the Levites, everyone in his work;

paite: hun sehsa a sing thillat a ding leh gah masa a ding in. Aw ka Pathian, hoihna ding in kei hon theigige in.
english: and for the wood offering, at appointed times, and for the first fruits. Remember me, my God, for good.
